title: Match the Shape
goal: Match each event variant and use its fields. Field order matters.
hints: The pattern names the variant AND binds its fields - the names must match what the arm's body uses.
Swapping x and y compiles perfectly. The test knows where you clicked.
explanation: Patterns destructure: Event::Click(x, y) tests the variant and binds both fields in one stroke. The wrong-arity pattern is rejected outright (E0023), the unqualified Key(c) doesn't resolve without a use - but the swapped Event::Click(y, x) compiles and lies: positions are meaning, and only the test notices the click reported mirror-imaged. Patterns are checked for shape by the compiler; for truth, by you.
